Questions 21–26

Who agrees with each of the following statements in Professor Smith's article?

Write the correct letter, A, B or C, next to Questions 21-26.

21 Old methods bring teaching problems

22 Students should be cautious when applying for an online course

23 Computers can be applied to certain courses

24 Personal contact is not helpful

25 Online courses improve technical skills

26 Online courses should have more time flexibility

A Peter only
B Lynne only
C both Peter and Lynne

Questions 27–30

Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

27 What does John Smith think about the usage of Internet on campus?

28 What's the meaning of John Smith's term “divided”?

29 What kind of help does John Smith think students should get?

30 Why is Professor Smith introducing the computers to school classrooms?

transcript.en: Lynne, I just finished reading Professor Smith’s article about the benefit of online courses. What are your thoughts on the article?
transcript.zh: 林恩，我刚读完史密斯教授关于在线课程的好处的文章。你对这篇文章有什么看法？

transcript.en: Hi, Peter. When I read that article, it was clear to me that Professor Smith does not favor the traditional methods of classroom teaching.
transcript.zh: 嗨，彼得。当我读到那篇文章时，我很清楚史密斯教授不赞成传统的课堂教学方法。

transcript.en: Although I can certainly acknowledge that there are some advantages to online course, I would say that internet courses are not always the best means for teaching and learning.
transcript.zh: 虽然我承认在线课程有一些优势，但我想说，互联网课程并不总是最好的教学和学习方式。

transcript.en: Well, I guess teaching and learning problems always exist no matter what method you are choosing.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我想无论你选择什么方法，教与学的问题总是存在的。

transcript.en: But generally, problems are more likely to arise when teaching is done through a traditional way.
transcript.zh: 但一般来说，通过传统方式进行教学时，更容易出现问题。

transcript.en: I think it’s about time to revolutionize the old teaching style though.
transcript.zh: 不过，我认为是时候彻底改变旧的教学方式了。

transcript.en: But I would hope that students consider the negatives of online learning before enrolling in online courses.
transcript.zh: 但我希望学生们在参加在线课程之前考虑在线学习的负面影响。

transcript.en: This shouldn’t be a big issue since online courses are so common these days. At least, I won’t struggle so much.
transcript.zh: 这应该不是什么大问题，因为现在在线课程非常普遍。至少，我不会那么纠结。

transcript.en: And Professor Smith points out that computer learning is well-suited for some courses, especially the technical courses. I think it makes sense to some extent based on my own experience.
transcript.zh: 史密斯教授指出，电脑学习非常适合某些课程，尤其是技术课程。根据我自己的经验，我认为这在某种程度上是有道理的。

transcript.en: That’s good, but unfortunately, that theory doesn’t work for me.
transcript.zh: 是很好，但不幸的是，这个理论对我不起作用。

transcript.en: What a shame, I got an A for that online computing course last year.
transcript.zh: 真可惜，我去年的在线计算课程得了A。

transcript.en: Anyway, the next part is … personal interaction.
transcript.zh: 反正，接下来就是……个人互动了。

transcript.en: I think the mutual interaction offered by traditional teaching is overrated in the article and doesn’t have much value.
transcript.zh: 我认为传统教学提供的互动在文章中被高估了，没有太大价值。

transcript.en: I think it’s a distraction and that time could be better spent on the subject matter of the course.
transcript.zh: 我认为这会分散注意力，最好把时间花在课程的主题上。

transcript.en: Oh, I disagree…strongly.
transcript.zh: 哦，我不同意……很不同意。

transcript.en: Peter, you’re dismissing the benefits of face-to-face interaction between students and teachers in traditional classroom settings.
transcript.zh: 彼得，你忽视了传统课堂环境中师生面对面互动的好处。

transcript.en: The article says that learning is a two-way street and it’s much easier for students to learn if they can ask questions and have discussions with their teachers.
transcript.zh: 文章说学习是个双行道，如果学生能提出问题和老师讨论，学习起来会容易得多。

transcript.en: I’m still not sure about that. But online courses can foster students’ technical skills.
transcript.zh: 对此我仍然不太确定。但是在线课程可以培养学生的技术技能。

transcript.en: In learning the subject matter online, students will gain the technical know-how they’ll need in their future endeavors.
transcript.zh: 通过在线学习，学生将获得他们未来研究所需的技术知识。

transcript.en: I didn’t pay much attention to that, but I do agree that students can learn very limited technical skills in a typical classroom, whereas they can learn more in an online course.
transcript.zh: 这方面我没太在意，但我同意学生在典型传统课堂上仅能学到非常有限的技术技能，而他们可以在在线课程中学到更多。

transcript.en: What do you think Professor Smith means when he says online courses should be flexible in time?
transcript.zh: 当史密斯教授说在线课程应该灵活安排时间，你认为他是什么意思？

transcript.en: That’s essential. The point of learning online is to allow those who can’t attend courses at fixed time to learn.
transcript.zh: 这很重要。在线学习的目的是让那些不能在固定时间上课的人学习。

transcript.en: The patterns of traditional teaching are different from those of online teaching, the former features a steady curriculum schedule and that’s where online teaching shows its edge.
transcript.zh: 传统的教学模式与网络教学的模式不同，前者的课程设置是固定的，这也是网络教学的优势所在。

transcript.en: I can’t agree more.
transcript.zh: 我完全同意。

transcript.en: The second part of the article shares some thoughts about the use of internet on campus. I’m kind of lost in that part.
transcript.zh: 文章的第二部分分享了一些关于在校园使用互联网的想法。我那个部分有点迷惑了。

transcript.en: Well, I think what he’s trying to say is that students are already accustomed to doing their research on the internet since it can be a huge waste of time if they look for the information by reading so many books.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我认为他想说的是，学生们已经习惯于在互联网上进行研究，因为如果他们通过阅读这么多书来寻找信息就太浪费时间了。

transcript.en: They always count on the internet. Although some people say computers could be better used for other purposes, he emphasizes that many teachers are already instructing students by using the computer as a research tool.
transcript.zh: 他们总是依靠互联网。尽管有人说电脑在达成其他目的方面可以被更好地利用，但他强调，许多教师已经在指导学生将计算机用作研究工具。

transcript.en: Thanks for clarifying that. What about the next part saying that students are “divided”, do you know what that means?
transcript.zh: 感谢你理清这一点。关于下一部分呢？说学生被“分”了，你知道这是什么意思吗？

transcript.en: Well, it’s certainly not that some students are not willing to use computers. They’re already well-accustomed to that.
transcript.zh: 嗯，当然不是有些学生不愿意使用电脑。他们已经习惯于使用电脑。

transcript.en: You’re right about that. Most students already use the internet as their primary source for news and information.
transcript.zh: 你说得对。大多数学生已经将互联网作为他们获取新闻和信息的主要来源。

transcript.en: Professor Smith probably intends to say that computers are not easily accessible and available to all students.
transcript.zh: 史密斯教授的意思可能是说计算机并不是所有学生都能简单获得和使用的。

transcript.en: Yes, not all students can afford computers.
transcript.zh: 是的，不是所有的学生都能买得起电脑。

transcript.en: Although many teachers encourage the use of other resources, many students prefer to use the internet, as they are most comfortable with computers and the internet.
transcript.zh: 虽然很多老师鼓励使用其他资源，但很多学生更喜欢使用互联网，因为他们最习惯使用电脑和互联网。

transcript.en: They have the internet at their fingertips, whereas other resources might take more time and energy to access.
transcript.zh: 他们有触手可及的互联网，而其他资源可能需要更多的时间和精力才能获得。

transcript.en: Yes, and as Professor Smith notes, with online courses, the student support system is already in place.
transcript.zh: 是的，正如史密斯教授所说，有了在线课程，学生支持系统已经到位。

transcript.en: Instead of asking fellow students or the professor for assistance, students would be able to get any information they need online. And this assistance would be available immediately.
transcript.zh: 学生们可以在线获得他们需要的任何信息，而不是向同学或教授寻求帮助。这种在线帮助可立即使用。

transcript.en: So, why do you think Professor Smith is recommending the use of computers as the school’s main means of educating students?
transcript.zh: 那么，你认为史密斯教授为什么建议使用计算机作为学校教育学生的主要手段？

transcript.en: Do you think he is interested in reducing some of the fees associated with traditional classroom courses?
transcript.zh: 你认为他有兴趣减少一些与传统课堂课程相关的费用吗？

transcript.en: I think it’s all about the money. He is promoting online courses simply because he thinks it will enable the school to make more money.
transcript.zh: 我认为都是与钱相关。他推广在线课程仅仅是因为他认为这将使学校赚更多的钱。

transcript.en: I never thought of it that way.
transcript.zh: 我从来没有这样想过。

transcript.en: Many schools already have limited space for classrooms.
transcript.zh: 许多学校的教室空间已经有限。

transcript.en: If the school board wants to enroll more students, they can do that through distance learning mode.
transcript.zh: 如果学校董事会想招收更多的学生，他们可以通过远程学习模式来做到这一点。

transcript.en: Instead of recruiting more teachers, the same course resources can be sold to both online and offline students.
transcript.zh: 不用多招老师，同样的课程资源就可以卖给线上和线下的学生。

transcript.en: Plus, some computer companies are willing to financially support the schools that promote this type of learning.
transcript.zh: 另外，一些计算机公司愿意在资金上支持推广这种学习方式的学校。

transcript.en: I see, this is profitable in every sense. Alright, now we’ll have something to write about in the research paper.
transcript.zh: 我明白了，这在任何意义上都是有利可图的。 好的，现在在研究论文中有的写了。
